task.title: Guidance test catches a renamed JSON member
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M83). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

The test that checks the JSON members named in the agent guidance does not catch a renamed member. Renaming the `version` tag still passed, because keys are pooled, the `data.` paths are matched only as text, and the skill's members are not checked.

## Wanted

Resolve each named path against the marshaled value it describes, for the guidelines and the skill.

## Done when

- Renaming any member the guidance names fails the test.
